facts.fact: CLG Global reports the compliance transition period under Law No. 2024/017 of 23 December 2024 on personal data protection closed on 23 June 2026, and says operators should assume its obligations apply now.

Law No. 2024/017 of 23 December 2024 creates the Autorité de protection des données à caractère personnel, a CLG Global analysis says, but its formal establishment depends on a presidential decree and it is not yet operational.
facts.system: Autorité de protection des données à caractère personnel
